data.desc: Offerpad Solutions Inc. (Nasdaq: OPAD) is a real estate solutions company focused on giving homeowners more control, flexibility, and choice when buying and selling a home. The Company provides Cash Offers, Agent listing services, access to additional cash buyers through marketplace-enabled capabilities, and renovation services that support both internal transactions and third-party partners. Founded in 2015, the Company combines proprietary technology with local real estate expertise to simplify the home sale process and reduce friction across the transaction lifecycle, helping customers move forward with speed, transparency, and confidence.
